Port of Benoni. The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of Benoni
situated in Barangay Benoni, Municipality of Mahinog, Province of Camiguin, is hereby
further expanded and delineated as follows:
Beginning at a point marked 1 on the plan, being S. 19 deg. 34'49" E., 1,684.20
m. from BLLM No. 1, PLS-1103, Mahinog, Camiguin, thence:

Containing a total area of TWO HUNDRED NINETY-EIGHT THOUSAND EIGHT

SQUARE DECIMETERS (298,828.142), more or less.

PPA Jurisdiction. The Benoni Port Zone, as expanded and
delineated, is hereby placed under the administrative jurisdiction of the PPA, which
shall, consistent with the regional industrial plans of the government, implement a
program for the proper zoning, planning, development and utilization of the port.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended
or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is declared
invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid
and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
